fileShredder.title: File Shredder & Secure Wipe
fileShredder.subtitle: Cryptographically sanitize and permanently destroy confidential files with multi-pass hardware overwriting.
fileShredder.quickZeroDesc: Single pass 0x00 overwrite. Fast for non-confidential large items.
fileShredder.dodDesc: CSPRNG random + bitwise inverse + random. Defeats laboratory data recovery.
fileShredder.gutmannDesc: Extreme security multi-cycle pseudo-random wiping for classified files.
fileShredder.dropZoneTitle: Select Files or Folders to Shred
fileShredder.dropZoneDesc: Select items below. They will be overwritten with cryptographic bytes, truncated, renamed, and completely unlinked.
fileShredder.warningDesc: Unlike standard trash deletion, shredding overwrites sector clusters before unlinking inodes. Files destroyed with this utility cannot be recovered by any commercial or hardware forensic tools.
fileShredder.confirmDesc: You are about to permanently destroy selected item(s) using multi-pass overwriting. This action is COMPLETELY IRREVERSIBLE.

gitSweeper.optimizeAllDesc: This will run "git gc --prune=now" on all detected repositories and prune merged local branches. Working trees remain safe.

welcome.step1Subtitle: Next-Gen Mac Cleaning & Optimization • Bayu Edition
welcome.step1Desc: Beberes keeps your Mac swift, clean, and spacious with native Rust-powered scanning.
welcome.pillarCleanDesc: Safely purge Xcode caches, browser temp data, orphaned apps, and system logs.
welcome.pillarTidyDesc: Declutter downloads, hunt massive duplicates, and speed up photo/video review.
welcome.pillarDevDesc: Wipe gigabytes of stale node_modules, target artifacts, and dormant git trees.
welcome.pillarSafetyDesc: All cleans route to macOS Trash by default. Never lose a file unexpectedly.
welcome.step2Subtitle: Grant Full Disk Access for Complete Scanning
welcome.step2Desc: macOS protects deep Library caches and user trash from third-party apps. Granting Full Disk Access enables Beberes to inspect and clean comprehensively without permission errors.
welcome.step2Action2: 2. Under Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access, find Beberes
welcome.step2Action3: 3. Toggle switch to ON (enter Mac password if prompted)
welcome.step3Desc: Beberes is fully primed and ready to optimize your machine.
welcome.tip1Desc: Press Cmd+K anytime to jump straight to any tool or trigger a scan.
welcome.tip2Desc: Switch deletion modes anytime directly from the TopBar toggle.
welcome.tip3Desc: Click the Refresh button on top right to rescan whatever view you are in.
welcome.privacyDesc: Zero telemetry and zero external server connections. Everything runs exclusively on your Mac.
welcome.safetyDesc: Critical macOS directories, SIP protected areas, and active applications are safely guarded by whitelists.
welcome.smartDesc: Reclaim space from node_modules, Docker containers, Xcode DerivedData, and simulators in 1 click.
welcome.subtitle: Ultra-fast, native, and local system cleaner & optimizer for macOS
